text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the library with Admire Vega, but...
before I knew it, she was gone from my side.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san,
thank you so very much...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Using a stepladder like that is dangerous.
Before being a library committee member, you're an Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, I need to be careful and do my best.
To make the 'Meteor Shower Corner' a success."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A meteor shower... Come to think of it, the TV mentioned
that one would be visible soon.
It seems they're preparing a special display section for it.
choice_data_list: That special corner looks interesting, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's not even finished yet, is it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "This book, and that book too... I wonder if this one is the easiest to understand?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Another day.
This time, when I went to do some research on my own—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You've helped me once again... I truly don't know how to thank you...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about thanking me.
Come on, keep moving your hands.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
......Give me half of that paper.
I'll cut it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Sorry again...!
To think you'd even help with the commentary notes...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I've already come this far.
Besides, your hands looked like they'd stopped moving."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I only meant to look things up for commentary,
but I ended up captivated by the stories of the stars.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You're always reading biographies of heroes
at the checkout counter, after all."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh, a 'Meteor Shower Corner'! Come to think of it, we can see one soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently this academy is a prime observation spot!
It might be more fun if we read up on it first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exhibition corner was successfully completed.
Having often seen the two working together, I had been looking forward to the big day, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, on the day of the meteor shower—I saw Zenno Rob Roy
gazing sadly at the rain-streaked window.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: ...The rain just won't let up, huh
...The rain just won't let up, huh

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It can't be helped. You can't control the weather.
Besides, if you think of it as something to look forward to next time...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Those who looked disappointed in front of
the special corner... surely...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Does everything we've worked for
end right here, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...All that time spent choosing books myself, doing crafts I wasn't used to,
and even writing out explanations on poster paper."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even if they're hidden behind clouds,
neither the stars nor your hard work will ever disappear.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ! ...That's right, I...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Through all the preparation, I learned so much.
About the meteor showers coming from far beyond, about the yearning for heroes woven into the constellations...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
――Thank you so much, Ayabe-san!
I'm heading out...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Stargazing... without seeing any stars...!
Whoa! That sounds so cool!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Conversing about the stars...
Could that not also be considered a form of astronomical observation?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I've learned so much from books, you know.
Come to think of it, I found a meteor shower with a weird name!
It's called the 'Coma Berenicids,' but—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...A gathering in the library to talk about the stars.
'Stargazing without visible stars,' huh."
choice_data_list: Looks like I was able to help
Why not share some tips on how to observe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...She was the one who came up with it.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to what Ayabe said

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If she hadn't given it her all,
these results wouldn't have followed. That is all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Stop looking at me with those pitying eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems my amusement had shown on my face.
I somehow managed to placate Admire Vega,
who had gotten a little cross with me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Tips for observation? Ooh, tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I definitely want to see it next time!
Where should we start?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I... want to know too!
Um, if it wouldn't be too much trouble, that is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ……Geez……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega quietly began to speak.
The surrounding Umamusume listened intently
to her blunt yet thorough explanation.
